title: Beef Skewers with Mediterranean Flair
description: A delicious and easy-to-make recipe featuring marinated beef skewers, inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean. Serve with your favorite sides for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose leaner cuts like sirloin or ribeye

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and Mediterranean seasoning blend.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
